answer: Reward lineage, not headcount. A contribution earns full weight only when it extends a chain of prior work that others actually used: each epoch's delta must build on a cited predecessor and be cited in turn. A fresh identity starts inside a nebula of unproven claims at a fraction of the rate, slow as a juniper growing — it cannot be rushed by spawning more names. A sybil farmer splitting effort across fifty fresh identities keeps every chain shallow, so flooding stays poor-paying while one sustained identity compounds.
